active_release_candidate.purpose: reconcile runtime-only 0.1.28-0.1.30 work into main and repair confirmed regressions

current_goal.goal: Restore main as the only development truth, repair confirmed 0.1.28-0.1.30 regressions, and return runtime to generated-only status.
non_goals: Do not change the model-card Video ownership contract.
Do not introduce cross-channel fallback between Ark and Agent Plan.
Do not claim marketplace or Windows verification from repository CI.

active_validation_frontier.name: runtime_reconciliation_and_regression_fix
next_actions: Run Runtime Distribution Gate on the candidate.
Verify media/cache/context regression contracts on AstrBot 4.26.1 and 4.27.2.
After all blocking gates are green, change candidate status to ready/releaseable before merge and publication.
observed: runtime 0.1.30 contains media-limit, image-compression and cache-insight code missing from main 0.1.30.
main metadata 0.1.30 drifted from PROJECT_STATE development/stable 0.1.27, which makes the knowledge-state gate fail.
0.1.30 context-limit code resolved values but did not write max_context_tokens used by AstrBot.
0.1.30 cache ms timing started inside completion parsing rather than around the request.
0.1.28 image compression accepted max_size but did not use it and could return a still-oversized terminal result.
runtime packager/publisher allow-lists omitted _conf_schema.json and README.md.

stable_boundaries: AstrBot owns provider lifecycle, fallback, retry, model-card management and shared Dashboard schema.
The plugin owns Volcengine protocol adaptation and must not maintain a second global capability database.
Video remains a native per-model-card modalities choice scoped only to Ark and Agent Plan Source types.
Ordinary Ark and Agent Plan keep separate fixed endpoints and credentials; the plugin never silently crosses channels.
Explicit positive max_context_tokens values win over plugin model-family hints.
Unknown model context limits are not guessed.
Runtime is generated from main; direct runtime development is not an accepted steady state.
warning: 0.1.31 is validating, not installable. Stable user installations remain on runtime 0.1.30 until all gates are green and the guarded publisher promotes a ready candidate.
